items.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value After Board Appointment
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group has delivered a 1 year gain that may catch your eye, even after a tougher multi year stretch. The live question is whether that share price now asks too much or too little of its earnings power. The stock is up 22.0% over the past year, which puts fresh pressure on the numbers to show that this move is supported by what the business earns. Recent board changes and a sharpened focus on medical cost management and pricing can influence how much profit each dollar of premium...
